title: Doubt Is the Beginning of Freedom

top_liked.author: @Ripple_Drops
top_liked.text: Truth doesn't mind questioning. Only lies do.

top_liked.author: @JP-lw3bt
top_liked.text: Being a black man growing up in the black church, having curiosity often got me scolded, embarrassed, and any dreams outside of the church i had were crushed, haven't been in church in years

top_liked.author: @cyraxox7440
top_liked.text: Just had this conversation with my wife yesterday, I pretty much consider myself agnostic now for the most part and am just now sort of ‘coming out’ so to speak with my doubts and why. She responded by abruptly leaving saying she was disappointed, shocked and hurt.

top_liked.author: @Ripple_Drops
top_liked.text: It's interesting the people who study the Bible most, lose faith in it, the most.

top_liked.author: @Ripple_Drops
top_liked.text: When we doubt, we only betray our own egos. Anything else, is just ego's justification.

top_liked.author: @jstube36
top_liked.text: Doubt is a valuable weapon against BS. It leads us to a path of better knowledge. And the first step toward greater enlightenment is asking questions. And the more we know the more we grow.
